description: Fix broken signup-to-first-deal user flow: duplicate pipeline creation during onboarding. The signup handler in lib/auth/api-handlers.ts already creates a 'Sales Pipeline' with 6 stages (Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost). Then, when the user goes through the onboarding wizard (app/api/tenant/onboarding/route.ts POST), it creates ANOTHER pipeline with stages from the industry template. This results in duplicate default pipelines, confusing the user. Also fix: the onboarding pipeline sets stages with 0-based order while signup uses 1-based order, causing inconsistent stage ordering. Additionally, the onboarding POST marks its new pipeline as isDefault=true but does NOT unset the previous default, leaving two pipelines marked as default.
steps: In app/api/tenant/onboarding/route.ts POST handler, before creating a new pipeline, check if a default pipeline already exists for the tenant. If it does, either (a) update its name and replace its stages, or (b) unset its isDefault flag before creating the new one.

Add a step to unset isDefault on any existing pipelines before marking the new one as default: `await tx.update(pipelines).set({ isDefault: false }).where(and(eq(pipelines.tenantId, ctx.tenantId), eq(pipelines.isDefault, true)));` before the pipeline insert.

Normalize stage ordering to be consistently 0-based across both signup and onboarding. In lib/auth/api-handlers.ts, change the default stages from order: 1-6 to order: 0-5 to match what onboarding uses.
In the onboarding pipeline creation, if deleting the old pipeline (option b), also clean up its deal stages to avoid orphaned rows. Use a transaction that deletes the old stages first.
acceptance_criteria: After signup + onboarding, only ONE pipeline is marked as isDefault=true
Stage ordering is consistent (0-based) across all pipeline creation paths
No orphaned deal stages exist from replaced pipelines
